October 1h, 196k. 


From the Public Relations Office 


FOUNDER'S DAY COMEMMORATION LECTURE 


The Montreal Young Men's Christian Association announces the third Founder's 
Day Lecture to take place Friday, October 16th in Birks Hall, 1435 Drummond St. The 
lecture immediately follows a dinner which begins at 6:30 p.m. 

Guest lecturer is Dr. Paul M. Limbert, B.A., BoDe, PHD, L.LoDo, LHD, 
DD. Following professorial posts at Teachers College Columbia University, Dr. 
Limbert became Professor of Education and Director of Graduate Education at Spring- 
field College, and was later named President. In 1952 he became Secretary General 
of the World Alliance of the YMCA in Geneva, Switzerland. In 1963 Dr. Limbert 
accepted the position of Executive Secretary of the YMCA's Blue Ridge Assembly in 
North Carolina. 

He is the author of three books and numerous articles and papers. His 
latest book, "New Perspectives for the YMCA" is the subject of much serious consi- 
deration by contemporary YMCA leaders. 

This special event, which honors Sir George Williams, founder of the 
YMCA in London, 18h, is convened annually to bring before the leaders of the 
Montreal Association, scholars and educators of international stature. 

Members of press, radio and television are cordially invited to attend 
Dr. Limbert's address. 


Harry E. Thomas 
Public Relations Secretary
